\section{Deferred proofs}
\label{sec:proofs}

\begin{proof}[Proof of Proposition~\ref{prop:stability}]
By Definition~\ref{def:resolvent}, $H_0 - zI : \dom(H_0) \to \mathcal{H}$ is
bijective with bounded inverse $R_{H_0}(z)$. Factoring on $\dom(H_0)$ gives
\[
H - zI = \bigl(I + V R_{H_0}(z)\bigr)(H_0 - zI).
\]
Since $\opnorm{V R_{H_0}(z)} \le \opnorm{V}\opnorm{R_{H_0}(z)} < 1$, the
bounded operator $I + V R_{H_0}(z)$ is invertible on $\mathcal{H}$ with
bounded inverse. Therefore $H - zI : \dom(H_0) \to \mathcal{H}$ is bijective
with bounded inverse $R_{H_0}(z)\bigl(I + V R_{H_0}(z)\bigr)^{-1}$, which
places $z \in \rho(H)$ by Definition~\ref{def:resolvent}.
\end{proof}

\begin{proof}[Proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:perturbation}]
By Proposition~\ref{prop:stability}, we have $z \in \rho(H)$ and the
factorized inverse $R_H(z) = R_{H_0}(z)(I + B)^{-1}$, where $B = V R_{H_0}(z)$
satisfies $\opnorm{B} \le \theta < 1$. Applying \eqref{eq:neumann-series}
gives
\[
R_H(z) - R_{H_0}(z) = R_{H_0}(z)\sum_{n=1}^{\infty} (-1)^n B^n
= - R_{H_0}(z) B (I + B)^{-1}.
\]
Using the norm estimate in \eqref{eq:neumann-series}, we obtain
$\opnorm{R_H(z) - R_{H_0}(z)} \le \opnorm{R_{H_0}(z)} \opnorm{B} (1 - \opnorm{B})^{-1}
\le \frac{\theta}{1 - \theta}\opnorm{R_{H_0}(z)}$.
\end{proof}
